source.inspection: Directly viewed existing photograph; clearly shows entrance canopy, cylindrical pillars, tiled facade, glass grid and right projecting canopy.
source.date_limit: Tour page updated2018-09-06; this is not established photograph capture date and not2026 current-condition evidence.

scope: Existing partial laboratory entrance/front two-level model only; color existing mesh faces, no new geometry.
color_encoding: Suggested sRGB hex approximate categories under photo lighting, not calibrated finish values.

regions.appearance: pale warm beige-grey with muted pink/taupe undertone
regions.notes: Do not make facade saturated pink or red. Fine square tile lines are reference texture, not authority to add topology.
Granular pale finish on main entry projecting roof, cylindrical columns and edge; underside shadow should come from lighting, not a black paint assignment.
Upper glazing appears milky pale green; ground glazing reflects surroundings and is somewhat darker. Opaque-print proxy acceptable. Do not reproduce unrelated vegetation reflections as painted wall.

regions.appearance: dull silver-grey with weathered warm tint

regions.notes: Distinct dark perimeter and ribs. Roof infill is translucent grey-green and should remain distinct from beams if existing geometry permits.
Use only on existing thin canopy panel surface. No invented transparent structure.
Do not convert dark weathering streaks into arbitrary strong colored bands.
Model truncation and simplified unseen back/side/top do not imply real rear finish. Preserve neutral treatment.

excluded_changes: Do not add blue Chinese or English lettering: not part of approved baseline geometry.
No new plaque text, lights, handrails, vegetation, tile relief, extra floors, roof gable or photographic detail not already modeled.
Preserve original STL,scene.blend,locked representative preview and topology; only additive appearance assets authorised.
Do not publish official photograph in model package.
